notes.title: Great Discount 45%
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!

I hope you haven't been bored, we are offering you a [b]45% discount[/b] on Holy Shift game.

The purpose of this discount is [b]to reach a certain number[/b] of sales, so that in the future the game will be [b]absolutely fre[/b]e.

[i]Yes, we know... it sounds strange that we ask you to buy the game at a discount and say that it will be free soon.[/i]

[b]But perhaps for you this amount of coins will not be critical, but for us it is.[/b]

Your Kitten Purradise Studios!

notes.title: Incoming Holy Shift and One Eleven Discount
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

That is why we present discounts at 20.01.2025 on these projects!!!

...And a great reminder to you that the One Eleven project will have a major patch very soon.
